name: 34685 · Palm Harbor, FL
findings: ZIP 34685 (Palm Harbor) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 22 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34685 (Palm Harbor) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34685 (Palm Harbor) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
